title: WaterWatchAI_WaterloggingEventRecord
description: Standardized schema for recording ground-truth municipal waterlogging events and verified negative control observations.

event_id.description: Unique event identifier (e.g., WW-NGP-2024-001 or CTRL-PUN-2024-042)

location_id.description: Station ID, municipal ward, or designated junction identifier (e.g., NGP-WARD-04, NGP-SITABULDI)

latitude.description: WGS-84 Latitude in decimal degrees (calibrated for Maharashtra State bounds: 15.0 to 23.5)

longitude.description: WGS-84 Longitude in decimal degrees (calibrated for Maharashtra State bounds: 72.0 to 82.5)

event_start_time.description: ISO 8601 onset timestamp (e.g., 2024-07-21T14:30:00+05:30). Must include date, time, and timezone offset.

event_end_time.description: ISO 8601 water recession timestamp (e.g., 2024-07-21T18:00:00+05:30). Null if duration is ongoing or unrecorded.

waterlogging_observed.description: Binary outcome label. 1 = Waterlogging observed. 0 = Verified absence of waterlogging (active negative control observation). DO NOT set to 0 merely because no incident was filed.

severity_level.description: Assessed physical severity: None (for verified controls), Low (<15cm, slow traffic), Moderate (15-30cm, lane closures), Severe (30-60cm, vehicle stall), Critical (>60cm, structural hazard/evacuation), Unknown.

water_depth_cm.description: Physically measured or staff-gauge recorded flood water depth in centimeters. Null if not objectively measured.

evidence_source.description: Originating organization or authority (e.g., Nagpur Municipal Corporation, Pune Traffic Police, IMD Observer).

verification_status.description: Quality tier. Only records with 'Verified_Official' or 'Verified_Field' should enter supervised training.

image_path.description: Relative or absolute filepath to photographic evidence, if available. Null if unrecorded.

annotator_id.description: Identifier of annotator, data ingestion operator, or official field inspector.

notes.description: Supplementary context (e.g., drainage pump failure, blocked stormwater culvert, underpass location).
